cards.title: Constraints Drive Innovation
cards.insight: Creative breakthroughs often emerge not from unlimited resources but from working within tight boundaries. Artists, engineers, and entrepreneurs consistently find that constraints—whether time, budget, or tools—force novel thinking and eliminate unnecessary complexity.
cards.takeaway: Next time you face a limitation, reframe it as a creative challenge rather than a roadblock; use it to generate unconventional solutions.

cards.title: Diverse Perspectives Compound Ideas
cards.insight: Creativity thrives at the intersection of different disciplines, backgrounds, and worldviews. Cross-pollination of ideas from unexpected sources generates combinations that a single perspective could never produce.
cards.takeaway: Actively seek collaborators and inputs from outside your domain; schedule 'idea collision' sessions with people from different fields.

cards.title: Iteration Beats Perfection
cards.insight: Most creative work improves through rapid cycles of making, testing, and refining rather than endless planning. Each iteration reveals gaps invisible in theory and builds momentum toward unexpected destinations.
cards.takeaway: Commit to showing rough work to others early and often; embrace feedback as fuel rather than criticism.

cards.title: Play Is the Gateway to Breakthrough Thinking
cards.insight: Creativity requires psychological safety and low-stakes experimentation. Playfulness—trying things without fear of failure—unlocks curiosity and risk-taking that formal planning suppresses.
cards.takeaway: Build regular "play time" into your work rhythm; protect spaces where failure is expected and rewarded as learning.
